text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I go watch Opera O and Doto in the Takarazuka Kinen. Ooooh, they're both even more amazing than ever!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: After the race, the two declare their rivalry. A feeling I can't describe wells up within me—but I can't tell if the heat comes from this fateful moment or something… else.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: There's only one way to find out, though. By running more races! Stay tuned next episode for the Japan Dirt Derby!
